description: NaVMnO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent MnO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 76-80°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.47 Å. V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent MnO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-55°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.72-1.79 Å. Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.39 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and two equivalent Mn atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and two equivalent Mn atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one V, and one Mn atom.
